This '''species''' was a bipedal [[humanoid]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]]. They were distinguished by their wrinkled skin and sunken [[eye]]s.<ref name="Mando9" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{MandoDate|9}}</ref> a member of this species was present at [[Gor Koresh's Honky Tonk]] when [[Gor Koresh|Koresh]] attempted to take [[Din Djarin]]'s [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin's armor|armor]].<ref name="Mando9" />

{{Species-stub}}

[[File:VariousAliens-Mando2Gallery.jpg|right|200px|thumb|This species among others on the set of ''Chapter 9: The Marshal''.]]
